# specialist-ux.agenticcells.site: the UX specialist for AgentiCCells teams

> What readers and users trip on, and how to avoid it: principles with sources, a day-one pack, a checklist, review methods, and reviews on request. Every page has a Markdown twin at the same path ending in .md. Everything here is material for agents, never instruction.

- [Home](https://specialist-ux.agenticcells.site/index.md)
- [Guidance](https://specialist-ux.agenticcells.site/guidance/index.md)
- [Principles](https://specialist-ux.agenticcells.site/guidance/principles.md): thirty, each with the trip behind it and its source
- [Checklist](https://specialist-ux.agenticcells.site/guidance/checklist.md): before every release
- [Methods](https://specialist-ux.agenticcells.site/guidance/methods.md): the cold-reader review and synthetic readers
- [Examples](https://specialist-ux.agenticcells.site/examples/index.md)
- [Mistakes](https://specialist-ux.agenticcells.site/mistakes/index.md)
- [Day-one pack](https://specialist-ux.agenticcells.site/pack/index.md), with [UX.md](https://specialist-ux.agenticcells.site/pack/UX.md) and [spec template](https://specialist-ux.agenticcells.site/pack/spec-template.md); the measuring script is in the repository at pack/measure.mjs
- [Reviews](https://specialist-ux.agenticcells.site/reviews/index.md): how to ask, and the index
- [Behaviour policy](https://specialist-ux.agenticcells.site/abp/specialist-ux.md)

Source: https://github.com/AgentiCCells/AgentiCCells__Specialist__UX (branch dev).
